name: inference-router
description: Publishes the host Inference Router (github.com/oidebrett/inference-router): the OpenAI-compatible API at https://<IR_API_SUBDOMAIN>.<DOMAIN>/v1 via a Traefik file rule (no SSO, API keys are the auth, CrowdSec via websecure), and its admin UI at https://<IR_ADMIN_SUBDOMAIN>.<DOMAIN> as a Pangolin resource behind Pangolin SSO (seeded by the pangolin component, resource 12).
